title: Dispatch: no folio is AGREED yet because agreement compares free text; fix the picture vocabulary, then run the picture-text statistics
statement: Text statistics cannot separate language from meaningless text (P-G-007, P-G-009); the drawings are the route. State of that route: 11 blind annotations of six folios are scored and none is AGREED: f70v2 0.747, f75v 0.653, f72r3 0.495, f67r2 0.406, f99r 0.398 (DISAGREE below 0.5), f66r not yet comparable. Much of the gap is the measure, not the drawings: vs/registry.py picture_agreement pairs objects by label locus or by kind in order and then compares free-text feature values by exact string, so 'tub with dotted grid' and 'dotted tub' disagree, and two seats who order the same ring from different starting points are compared object against wrong object. Before more annotation: (1) a code: change giving picture.json a closed vocabulary (per kind, a few keys with enumerated values, e.g. container_pattern: plain|dotted|hatched|striped|scales|circles; headgear: none|cap|band|crown; posture: upright|reclining|inverted; colour: none|green|blue|red|yellow), free text kept in a notes field that agreement ignores; (2) pair objects by position (ring and angle, or reading order on the page), not by list order. Then re-annotate the six folios. Separately, the label problem from the last dispatch stands: on zodiac circles a blind seat cannot tie a label line id to a figure, so some annotations on the record carry ring labels that only one seat could have assigned by guessing an order; P-L4-013 should weight only labels tied by a drawn line or by unambiguous position (f75v tags, f66r). The statistics themselves are written: branch code-P-L4-013-fleet-opus adds picture_label (same_object_label, feature_label_share, label_in_page_text) and the null shuffle_picture_labels to vs/dsl.py with tests; they refuse until AGREED annotations give at least 20 labelled objects.
check: None: a dispatch. Sources: registry picture items V-001..V-011 (agreement values), vs/registry.py picture_agreement, branch code-P-L4-013-fleet-opus.
